scientific_integrity: The four numerical checks use high-precision decimal logarithms with large positive margins. The reduction from all intervening primes to four checks is proved by the maximal-gap interval argument and monotonicity, not inferred from sampling.
scientific_limitations: Finite verification only. The argument extends the published common frontier through the interval ending immediately before the 85th maximal-gap start; it does not prove any conjecture globally and depends on the correctness of the record-gap table and prime-index data.
title: Prime-gap verification of the Firoozbakht, Nicholson, and Farhadian conjectures to the 85th record-gap start
